frames.subject: One old parking-structure toll booth, about 2 metres wide, 4 metres long and 2.8 metres tall: a narrow steel cashier cabin standing on a raised concrete kerb island, a wraparound band of dark opaque tinted windows on all sides, a flat overhanging roof cap in dark grey steel, a sliding side door, a small cash drawer hatch, dented kick panels, a short hazard-striped yellow and black bollard at the kerb nose. The original faded grey-green enamel (#5E6A62) is mostly sprayed over by a fight league in loose hand-sprayed blocks and drips of ember orange (#CF6F2A) and mustard (#D6A23E), abstract shapes only, no lettering. On one side a small round black seal disc with a thin deep-red rim, cut straight through by one knife slash. Decades old, scuffed, patched, still standing, no text
